identity.name: PandaSet sequence 001
identity.description: PandaSet sequence 001: 80 frames at 10 Hz, one combined Pandar lidar stream, six cameras, world-frame 3D cuboids, and aligned per-point semantic labels.

provenance.author: codex
provenance.summary: Complete PandaSet sequence 001 adapter using microsecond timestamps, per-frame ego poses, world-frame lidar/cuboids, six rigid camera mounts, and aligned semantic labels.
assumptions: PandaSet camera mounts are rigid and are computed from frame-0 world poses.
Both lidar heads are intentionally exposed as one pandar stream while retaining the d head attribute.
JPEG dimensions are 1920x1080, confirmed from the encoded image header.
PandaSet cuboid dimensions.x is the width and dimensions.y the length (y-forward frame), so dimensionFields are [y, x, z].

PandaSet cuboid yaw points along the box's local x axis, which is the width axis (length is dimensions.y). EgoLens headings point along the length axis, so the heading is yaw + pi/2 with dimensionFields [y, x, z].
